fact: The Cameroon Climate Innovation Hub (CAMCIH), an NGO housed at ICT University in Yaounde, was officially launched as an incubation and collaboration platform, with training programmes still planned.

Douala Tech Park, launched in October 2024 at the Institut JFN with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure and Dassault Systemes backing, aims to train 10,000 talents by 2030; no startup programme is stated.
Douala and Yaounde host new accelerators such as ActivSpaces and international hubs such as Orange Fab, per TechCabal.
Hubs and incubators are named in Douala, Yaounde and Buea (ActivSpaces, SM Ventures), per TechCabal.
